info.title: Le Concierge API
info.description: Plex-authenticated Hub API. Private routes require a verified Plex session with access to the configured server. Discord linking is optional. Cookies are HttpOnly; provider tokens never reach the browser.

200.description: Verified prepared attachment. No-store; no secrets or upstream URLs in headers.

post.description: Native same-origin POST with an empty body. Owner/session revalidated before bytes. No Range or URL tickets. Streaming uses bounded buffers and aborts at logout, revocation, expiry or disconnect. A lost/expired job is never recreated automatically.

get.description: Search the configured Plex server by title with the current Hub member token, or browse children of a show or season. Supply exactly one of q and parent. A Downloadarr connection is not required. Responses expire within 30 seconds and follow the current Hub session lifetime. No playback or conversion is started.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Title search; mutually exclusive with parent. Trimmed, with no control characters.

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: Personal Plex show or season rating key; mutually exclusive with q.

200.description: One personal page of films/shows, seasons, or episodes.

default.description: Private error; no stale library results.

200.description: Private poster, at most 2 MiB. Never cached.

sessionCookie.name: __Host-concierge_session
sessionCookie.description: HttpOnly cookie; concierge_session for loopback development only.

discordId.description: Optional Discord identity, linked after Plex login.

discordLogin.description: Optional Discord account linking is configured; this does not authenticate access to the Hub.

plexLink.description: Plex sign-in is configured and required to enter the Hub.

notifications.description: Private removal reminder inbox is configured. Optional Discord delivery has its separate discordDMs capability and explicit consent.

departures.description: Personal recorded viewing history; automatic reminders remain separate.

discordDMs.description: Explicit opt-in Discord removal reminders are configured.

extensionRequests.description: Fresh departure requests can be submitted to configured administrators.

posterUrl.description: Private same-origin Plex poster, checked with the current personal grant.

nextOffset.description: Raw Plex cursor; null on the final page or at the 10000 offset boundary. Episode grouping never changes this cursor.

createdAt.description: Request creation time normalized to RFC3339 UTC. An empty string explicitly means the source date is missing or invalid.

allUnwatched.description: Explicit opt-in to reminders for all personally accessible media positively marked unwatched by Plex.

discordDmEnabled.description: Separate explicit consent for Discord removal reminders; omission on PUT disables DMs.

availableUnwatched.description: Separate opt-in to one delayed reminder per personal request/season, 30 to 90 days after both request and Plex addition, with no current removal risk. Omission on PUT disables it.

SubscriptionInput.description: TMDB identity; season only for TV. Whole series/season tracks first accessible episode. Discord availability alerts currently return channel_unavailable.
